name: business-obligations
description: Open-source TypeScript rules engine: describe a US business, get the licenses, permits, filings and deadlines it needs, ordered and sourced. Zero dependencies.

paragraphs: What licenses, permits, filings and deadlines does a US business need? Describe the business, get the list, in order.
Try it in your browser: no install; the plan is computed in your browser.

Built for formation and compliance tools, accounting and payroll software, SaaS onboarding flows, and anyone who needs "what does this business owe, to whom, and by when?" as data rather than a pile of agency pages.
features: Honest about its confidence. Each state records what was checked against official pages and on what date; what
Specific, not generic. All 50 states and DC have their own filing agency, report fees and deadlines, unemployment
Cited to the page that matters. Every item's url is the agency page for that obligation (for example the
Derivable. If an obligation depends on a fact (headcount, payroll, activity in another state), that fact is an
Versioned law. Dated rule changes are bundled, so you can see what changes next quarter and prepare.

requirements.text: No network, no I/O, no account, no API key: the same profile always gives the same answer, so you can test it, cache it and run it anywhere (Node, browsers, edge).
